title: Kurigalu Saar Kurigalu

poet.name: K. S. Narasimhaswamy
poet.biography: K. S. Narasimhaswamy was a prominent Indian poet in the Kannada language. His most popular collection of poems 'Mysuru Mallige' has seen more than thirty-two reprints and is sought after as an ideal gift for newly married couples in Karnataka.

content:
Kurigalu saar kurigalu
Onde samane saagidavu...
bhavartha: This poem is a satirical take on the herd mentality of humans, comparing them to sheep following each other blindly without questioning their path or purpose.

difficultWords.context: Used metaphorically for people blindly following others.

title: Mankuthimmana Kagga

poet.name: D. V. Gundappa
poet.biography: Devanahalli Venkataramanayya Gundappa, popularly known as DVG, was a Kannada writer, poet, and philosopher. His most famous work is the Mankuthimmana Kagga, which is often referred to as the 'Bhagavad Gita of Kannada'.

content:
Hullagu bettada adi manege malligeyagu
Kallagu kashtagala malehodiye edeyolage...
bhavartha: A philosophical verse advising one to be humble like a blade of grass at the foot of a mountain, sweet like a jasmine flower to one's home, and strong like a rock when faced with difficulties.
